extension.summary: Shows the Red Light Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy details.
extension.description: Opens the Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy show and episode details, so its style can be checked without playing an episode. The buttons only close the popup, and Back or Escape also closes it. Does not need Red Light.
extension.news: 1.0.5: The popup sits 10 px further left and 2 px higher, so it clears the right edge of a TV. The outline is a little lighter and the shadow is a little more transparent. 1.0.4: The thumbnail sits in the left column with 12 px rounded corners, and the countdown and buttons sit in the right column. The season premiere or finale banner shows on the thumbnail. The popup is 542 px wide and 148 px tall. 1.0.3: The popup is 602 px wide and 108 px tall, with 30 px padding on the left and right. The shadow and panel follow the new size. 1.0.2: The add-on icon has a new file name, so Kodi shows the Autoplay icon on every device. No other changes. 1.0.1: Opens over a demo background image. The popup has the new layout, 20 px corners, a 1.5 px outline and a drop shadow. The icon is an Autoplay button. 1.0.0: First release. Shows Red Light's Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy details.
